name: Disodium cocamido MEA-sulfosuccinate
description: Disodium cocamido MEA-sulfosuccinate (CAS 68784-08-7 ) is a mild anionic surfactant derived from coconut fatty acids, used primarily for its foaming, cleansing, and emulsifying performance in aqueous formulations. Its low irritation profile makes it a preferred co-surfactant in rinse-off and leave-on systems where skin and eye compatibility are critical sourcing criteria for manufacturers and formulators. In personal care, it functions as a primary or secondary surfactant in baby shampoos, facial cleansers, and body washes, where formulators require effective cleansing without compromising mildness. It boosts foam volume and stability in sulfate-free shampoo systems, helping brands meet consumer demand for gentler hair care. In liquid hand soaps, it contributes degreasing performance while keeping products compatible. Industrial and institutional cleaning formulations use it to improve soil dispersion and surface wetting at moderate use levels. It is highly effective for sensitive-skin claims in household cleaners. Disodium cocamido MEA-sulfosuccinate is typically supplied as an aqueous solution, with active matter content commonly in the range of 35–40%. It is available in technical and cosmetic grades. Cosmetic-grade material is suitable for use in regulated personal care products.
